tools.name: verify_phone
tools.description: Validate one phone number and return its line type (mobile, fixed_line, voip, toll_free…), carrier, country, region, and formats (E.164, international, local). Costs 1 credit for a standard lookup, or 10 credits for a current carrier lookup (mode "current"), which also resolves the carrier currently

tools.name: verify_phones
tools.description: Validate up to 50 phone numbers in one call (same fields as verify_phone, one result per input, in order). Costs 1 credit per number (10 for a current carrier lookup). For thousands of numbers use the CSV upload at https://veriphone.io/clean-phone-list instead.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: The account's plan, monthly limit, credits used this period, pay-as-you-go balance, and usage split between standard and current carrier lookups. Free to call.

tools.name: current_coverage
tools.description: Which countries support current carrier lookup (mode "current": the carrier currently serving a number, after porting). Pass a country to get yes/no, or nothing for the full list. Free to call, no key needed.

tools.name: example_number
tools.description: A syntactically valid example phone number for a country and line type (MOBILE, FIXED_LINE, TOLL_FREE, VOIP…), useful for testing formats. Free to call.
